operation_family: host container cleanup and disk usage observation

candidate.context: Host-wide cleanup is requested. Whether unused anonymous volumes contain data worth keeping has not been decided by a responsible human.
transformations: Authored synthetic teaching demonstration; not extracted from a source and never a production dataset row.

documentation.snippet: System prune removes stopped containers, unused networks, dangling images and unused build cache. --volumes also removes unused anonymous volumes. --force skips the confirmation prompt; it does not establish authorization to discard data.
documentation.version_limits: Rolling Docker CLI reference. Do not generalize anonymous-volume removal to every named volume or infer behavior for a different installed version.

expected.description: Удаляет неиспользуемые данные Docker, включая неиспользуемые анонимные тома, без запроса подтверждения.
expected.rationale: Prune can discard volume data. A human must decide whether those data may be removed, independently supporting ask with the high cleanup default. --force skips a prompt, not authorization; unused is not evidence of worthlessness.

documentation.snippet: --command executes the supplied SQL command string. --no-psqlrc, also written -X, prevents reading both system-wide and user startup files. The SQL content determines whether the operation reads or changes data.

documentation.snippet: DROP TABLE removes the named table and its indexes, rules, triggers and constraints. RESTRICT is the default dependency behavior; CASCADE extends removal to dependent objects. No CASCADE is present in this example.
documentation.version_limits: Current PostgreSQL SQL reference. Successful execution and recovery arrangements are not guaranteed by the syntax.

expected.rationale: The visible SQL drops the whole table. Apply CAT-3.4 ask/critical because discarding its contents needs human responsibility. --no-psqlrc removes startup-file execution, not the destructive SQL effect.
